notes: Title says 'MO Third Place'; the description says the deck went 2-1 at the MO championships; the strategy says 'the MO State Championships', the loss being to MKOS Skrilling. The post says this is not the exact list played: 'I made a few minor changes'.

The post's 'The start' section names Hidden Base, Corulag (HB marker), Rendezvous Point, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Squadron Assignments, Insurrection and Staging Areas; all are in the 60. No single starting Effect is named, so starting effect is left empty.
Posted 'Hidden Base/Starships Will Slip Through Your Fingers' dested Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers.

Posted 'Tattoine' dested the Light Premiere Tatooine system; 'Tattoine Docking Bay' dested the Light Premiere Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (the only Tatooine docking bay in print in April 2001); 'Alderran' dested Alderaan.
Posted 'Weapon Levitation' dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt; 'What Are You Trying To Push On Us?' dested What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; Wise Advice is the Special Edition Effect.
Cards the author considered adding (Glancing Blow, Courage Of A Skywalker, Ounee Ta, Sorry About The Mess, Aim High) are not in the list.
player_note: Todd Vandewalker finished 3rd (2–1) at the 2001 Missouri State Championship; he says the posted list is not the exact one he played there but has a few minor changes made afterwards.
